Bitwise or. Usually accessed via the `|||` operator.

name: Nat.lor

source.code:
/--
Bitwise or. Usually accessed via the `|||` operator.

Each bit of the resulting value is set if the corresponding bit is set in at least one of the inputs.
-/
@[extern "lean_nat_lor"]
def lor  : @& Nat → @& Nat → Nat := bitwise or
